dedupe_keys.name: kenya number of hospital icu beds per county march 2020

description: This small table lists the intensive care beds in Kenyan hospitals, county by county, as counted at the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. The producers are the Kenya Healthcare Federation and the Critical Care Society of Kenya; the Kenya Open Data Initiative published it on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Coverage is national, with about 100 hospitals across the counties, as of 30 March 2020. Each row gives the county, the hospital and its number of ICU beds. The file is available as a free XLSX download under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: it is a one-off count from March 2020 that predates the pandemic expansion of critical care, the publisher is now inactive, hospitals have no coordinates or codes, and it is not stated whether private and public ICUs were counted in the same way. Simulation uses: setting critical care capacity in epidemic and mass-casualty models for Kenya, identifying counties without ICU beds, and planning patient transfers between counties. Related records: the WHO health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) give national bed ratios, and the HeiGIT accessibility indicators (data-heigit-accessibility-indicators) give travel times to hospitals.
